_comment: Bethesda's text is never edited, and Bethesda's books almost never name one
another by exact title — scanning the corpus finds barely fifty references
in a quarter of a million words, and four of the five sealed books are named
by nobody at all. Without something more, the sealed shelf could not be
reached, and a sealed book nobody can reach is not a mystery, it is missing.
So these references are the ARCHIVE's, not the author's. They are what a
librarian would pencil at the foot of a related volume, and the reader shows
them that way: a colophon set apart from the text, in the marginal hand,
after the tailpiece. Nothing here alters a single word of the book itself.
`from` and `cites` are titles rather than call numbers, because call numbers
are assigned by the importer and would silently rot if the source library
ever inserted a book. build-seed.mjs resolves them and fails loudly on a
